speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: I would invite the Member to seek clarifications if need be.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: If the question has been addressed, it may not be necessary to proceed with the question for future Sittings.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: These include subsidies for education, healthcare, childcare and infant care, the foreign domestic worker levy concession and the Child Development Account.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: In addition, those in need of assistance can approach their nearest Social Service Office.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And I thank the Minister for the reply.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I have seen first-hand the suffering and pain that single unwed parents go through.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, could I ask for the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) look at it from two different perspectives.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: One, for the cash component of the Baby Bonus, it really is not a luxury for them, but a lifeline.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, when the child is born, the mother and child, with $700, what can they really do?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I hope we can provide this cash component because it really is a lifeline for these parents.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Minister Indranee, Minister of State Sun Xueling and myself saw first-hand how single unwed parents were in tears when they spoke about this stigma and discrimination.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I think this policy of not providing this tax rebate and tax relief really reinforces the stigma and discrimination.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, I hope again, that we will relook this, not from a fiscal standpoint, but how giving them this relief and tax rebate can help to remove that discrimination.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I can understand how Mr Louis Ng feel for single unwed mothers.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: They must be implemented for public accountability, for the purpose it was intended.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Therefore, if they need support like the areas which the Member has mentioned, our Social Services Offices (SSOs) provide psychological support and social support.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: If they do not know where to go, I hope Members can point them to where these are.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: We thought at first it was to help the higher-income mothers to have children, but now, we are changing it to help the lower- and middle-income mothers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: So, why can we not change it to help the single unweds as well?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I do not think a lot of single unwed parents pay taxes because again, the median salary is about $700 for those under age 35.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: But this is about really removing the stigma and discrimination.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I have raised this for many years now.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Every year when I raise it, they said we will review it.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I hope we sincerely review this and change our policies.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I note that the Member said the numbers are small.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Does the Member want the number to be big?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: There is always this worry that that could happen, but more importantly, our policies must reflect the social norms and values of parenthood within marriage.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: We have several PQs to get through, Mr Ng.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: I will allow the last short supplementary question, please.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: The short supplementary question is this: we did equalise the maternity leave; we did provide the CDA component.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I do believe that that did not result in a spike in the number of single unweds.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I believe, in Japan as well, when they provided more support for single unwed parents, that also do not result in a spike in single unweds in the country.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I do not think people have children just because —

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Well, the Member did not put a question, but he put his opinion across again.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: I think he has reflected the needs of the unwed mothers – and all of us should feel the same.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: But we also have to reflect the needs and the reflections of what social norms are.

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: As I mentioned just now, if social norms change, that too will change.
